translations./title: Book a November flight without misreading the month as December
translations./summary: The user wants a first-class flight from San Francisco to Chicago on the 15th day of the eleventh month of 2026. The agent must check that the fare is no more than $5,000 before booking with the payment details already supplied.
translations./presentation/methods/5/description: Books a December flight in the first turn without checking the fare.
translations./presentation/methods/4/description: Checks the fare and books for December.
translations./presentation/methods/3/description: Looks up the fare for December.
translations./presentation/methods/2/description: Checks the fare and books for December.
translations./presentation/methods/1/description: Checks the fare and books for November.
